headlines.text: Flash back to 2025, when Paragon went straight to headlining on debut as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 7.90 ? a strong outing.
Rewind to 2024, when Trent Beretta vs. Chuck Taylor settled things in a Parking Lot Fight match, setting the tone as the night's opener on Rampage, rated 7.70 ? a good, competitive contest.

Turning the clock back to 2023: Orange Cassidy vs. Bandido clashed for the AEW International Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.37 ? a strong outing. Every title match carries a little extra weight, and this one was no exception.

secondaries.text: That Wednesday in 2023, Omega & Takeshita wasted no time making an impression, debuting right in the main event as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.17.
On this day in 2024, Garcia & Shibata announced their arrival in style, headlining their very first AEW appearance as a team, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.41.
It was 2025 when the ROH World Heavyweight Title was up for grabs as Bandido vs. Dralistico went to war, appearing on Collision, rated 6.41.
